headline:
A balanced portfolio still lives
in three places.

columns.title: At a broker
columns.text: Market hours only, out of reach for much of the world.

columns.title: In a vault or a fund
columns.text: Another account, another custodian, another set of fees.

columns.title: On an exchange
columns.text: Which holds the keys and offers baskets of crypto alone.

bar: Xindex puts all three into one token you own.
